titleZh: 2000–2023年中国及周边地区近地表冻融数据集
titleEn: A dataset of near-surface freeze-thaw cycles in China and surrounding regions from 2000 to 2023
introductionZh: 近地表冻融循环是陆地表层热力变化的基本特征, 是研究寒区冻土分布和气候变化的重要参数。近几十年来, 全球变化导致了近地表冻融过程和格局的变化。为支撑气候变暖背景下冻融循环研究和环境影响分析, 制备了2000–2023年中国及周边地区近地表冻融数据集。首先, 基于最新的ERA5-Land逐时温度数据, 采用阈值法和时空填补法, 得到了经过质量控制的日最高温度、日最低温度和日均温度。其次, 在细化冻融循环过程的基础上, 采用日最高温度和日最低温度判定了年和日尺度上的冻融状态, 结合日均温度, 计算得出了近地表年冻融天数、年冻融强度等相关的10个冻融循环特征。本数据集空间分辨率为0.1°和0.01°, 地理范围介于3°N–54°N, 60°E–136°E, 涉及中国、俄罗斯、蒙古国、巴基斯坦、塔吉克斯坦、吉尔吉斯斯坦等20余个国家及地区。ERA5-Land逐时气温数据逐年精度评估结果表明：R 2 在0.98以上, RMSE在1.5℃以内。数据集验证结果表明：冻融状态的总体分类精度为87%, 冻融期最大RMSE小于 30?d,冻融强度最大RMSE小于456℃?d。本数据集具有现势性强、要素多、覆盖范围广等特点, 可为气候变化背景下近地表冻融循环过程演变规律及其对冰冻圈、水文、生态、环境等的影响研究提供基础数据支撑。
introductionEn: The near-surface freeze-thaw cycle is a fundamental feature of land surface thermal changes and serves as an important parameter for studying the permafrost distribution and climate change in cold regions. In recent decades, global climate change has altered freeze-thaw processes and patterns. To support research on freeze-thaw dynamics and environment impact analysis in the context of climate warming, we prepared a near-surface freeze-thaw dataset for China and surrounding regions from 2000 to 2023. First, we obtained quality-controlled daily maximum, minimum, and average temperatures based on the latest ERA5-Land hourly temperature dataset using the threshold method and space-time filling method. Second, by refining the characterization of the freeze-thaw cycle process, we determined freeze–thaw states at both annual and daily scales based on daily maximum and daily minimum temperatures. In combination with daily average temperature, we calculated 10 freeze-thaw indices, including annual freeze-thaw days and annual freeze-thaw intensity near the surface. The dataset provides gridded products at spatial resolution of 0.1° and 0.01° across geographic domain of 3°N–54°N and 60°E–136°E, covering more than 20 countries and regions, including China, Russia, Mongolia, Pakistan, Tajikistan and Kyrgyzstan. The results of year-to-year accuracy assessment of the ERA5-Land hourly temperature dataset indicates an R 2  above 0.98 and an RMSE below 1.5°C. The validation results from ground stations shows an overall classification accuracy of 87% for the freeze-thaw state, with a maximum RMSE of less than 30 days for the freeze-thaw period, and less than 456°C?d for the maximum RMSE of the freeze-thaw intensity. This dataset is characterized by timeliness, rich variables and wide spatial coverage, providing a basic data resources for the studies on the evolution of near surface freeze-thaw cycles under climate change and their impacts on the cryosphere, hydrology, ecology, and the environment.

titleZh: 小麦白粉病图库数据集
titleEn: Wheat powdery mildew dataset
introductionZh: 小麦白粉病。小麦白粉病是一种世界性病害，在各主要产麦国均有分布，我国山东沿海、四川、贵州、云南发生普遍，危害也重。近年来该病在东北、华北、西北麦区，亦有日趋严重之势。该病可侵害小麦植株地上部各器官，但以叶片和叶鞘为主，发病重时颖壳和芒也可受害。。[防治方法]种子选取：种植抗病品种可选用郑州8915、郑州831、豫麦9、15、16、21、24号，中育4号，北农9号，冀麦23、24、26号、84—5418、138号，鲁麦1、5、7号，城辐752，高38、贵阿1号、贵丰1号、贵农19、20、21、22，黔丰3号，81—7241，冬丰1号，BT8812，BT一7032，京核883，8814，花培28，鲁麦14、22号，中麦2号，京农8445等。此外新选育的抗白粉病冬小麦品种还有百农64，温麦4号，周麦9号，新宝丰，冀审4185，6021新系，皖麦25，26，扬麦158，川麦25，绵阳26，劲松49号，早麦5号，京华1号，3号，京核3号，京411，北农白等。春小麦抗白粉病的品种有垦红13号、垦九5号、定丰3号等。上述抗病新品种，各地可因地制宜选用。如北京冬小麦现在以京411为主栽品种，高肥麦田搭配种植京冬8号、京冬6号、中麦9号。中肥及水浇条件差的种植京437、京核1号、轮抗6号等抗旱、耐瘠的品种。稻茬麦及晚播麦田可选用京411、京冬8号、京双18等。[农业防治]提倡施用酵素菌沤制的堆肥或腐熟有机肥，采用配方施肥技术，适当增施磷钾肥，根据品种特性和地力合理密植。中国南方麦区雨后及时排水，防止湿气滞留。中国北方麦区适时浇水，使寄主增强抗病力。自生麦苗越夏地区，冬小麦秋播前要及时清除掉自生麦，可大大减少秋苗菌源。
introductionEn: Wheat powdery mildew. Wheat powdery mildew is a worldwide disease, which is distributed in all major wheat-producing countries. It occurs widely in the coastal areas of Shandong, Sichuan, Guizhou and Yunnan provinces and causes serious harm. In recent years, the disease has become more and more serious in wheat areas of Northeast, North China and Northwest China. The disease can damage the above-ground organs of wheat plants, but mainly leaves and leaf sheaths. Glume shell and awn can also be damaged when the disease is serious. [Control methods] Seed selection: Zhengzhou 8915, Zhengzhou 831, Yumai 9, 15, 16, 21, 24, Zhongyu 4, Beinong 9, Jimai 23, 24, 26, 84-5418, 138, Lumai 1, 5, 7, Chengfu 752, Gao 38, Guifeng 1, Guinong 19, 20, 21, 22, Qianfeng 3, 81-7241, Dongfeng 1, BT8812, BT-7032, Jinghe 883, etc. 8814, anther culture 28, Lumai 14, 22, Zhongmai 2, Jingnong 8445, etc. In addition, Bainong 64, Wenmai 4, Zhoumai 9, Xinbaofeng, Jishen 4185, 6021, Wanmai 25, 26, Yangmai 158, Chuanmai 25, Mianyang 26, Jinsong 49, Zaomai 5, Jinghua 1, 3, Jinghe3, Jing411, Beinongbai and so on were newly bred wheat varieties resistant to powdery mildew. Spring wheat varieties resistant to powdery mildew include Kenhong 13, Ken 95 and Dingfeng 3. The new disease-resistant varieties mentioned above can be selected according to local conditions. For example, Beijing winter wheat is now mainly cultivated in Beijing 411, and high-fertility wheat fields are combined with Jingdong 8, Jingdong 6 and Zhongmai 9. Drought-resistant and barren-resistant varieties such as Jing437, Jinghe No. 1 and Lunkang No. 6 were planted under medium fertilizer and poor irrigation conditions. Beijing 411, Jingdong 8 and Jingshuang 18 can be selected for rice stubble wheat and late sowing wheat fields. [Agricultural control] Enzyme-fermented compost or decomposed organic fertilizer should be advocated. Formula fertilization technology should be adopted, phosphorus and potassium fertilizer should be increased appropriately and planted reasonably according to variety characteristics and soil fertility. In order to prevent moisture retention, wheat areas in southern China should drain water in time after rain. Water the wheat in the north of China in time to enhance the disease resistance of the host. In the areas where autumn wheat seedlings oversummer, it is necessary to remove autumn wheat before autumn sowing, which can greatly reduce the source of autumn wheat seedlings.

titleZh: 中国四川省龙洞山溪鲵正模标本（CIB 14380）高精度μCT扫描源数据集
titleEn: μCT source dataset of the holotype (CIB 14380) of Batrachuperus londongensis from Sichuan Province, China
introductionZh: 小鲵科蝾螈类是有尾两栖类的一个原始类群，对了解蝾螈类的早期演化具有重要意义。由于该科化石稀少、对现存属种骨骼形态研究不足、基于分子数据的分支分析结果不一致以及缺少利用形态特征构建分支演化树的原因，该科的起源、特征演化和内部谱系关系存在诸多分歧。龙洞山溪鲵生活于中国四川峨眉山龙洞河，是现存小鲵类中唯一具有童体型的蝾螈，即某些成年个体不经过变态发育而保留幼体特征。该属种自发现至今已有40年，然而此前未有对其骨骼系统的详细研究。本文利用成都生物研究所Quantum GX microCT Imaging System对龙洞山溪鲵的正模标本（CIB 14380）分段进行了高精度扫描（μCT），所得分辨率在67.1-144 μm之间。扫描结果揭示出童体型骨骼的多个特殊形态特征，如舌器骨化程度较高、肢骨的腕骨和跗骨完全骨化。这是μCT扫描技术在中国现存小鲵类骨骼形态研究中的首次应用。本数据集包括正模标本的μCT扫描原始数据、扫描参数、头骨和全身骨骼的三维重建图和视频、头部的3D pdf和可用于3D打印的stl文件。扫描所获取的骨骼结构在任意截面上轮廓清晰可辨，读者可利用常用三维软件，如VG Studio读取并使用该数据。以上文件的共享为相关科研人员提供了可供参照对比的原始数据，对小鲵科我国特有属种的形态特征研究具有一定价值。
introductionEn: The hynobiids are a primitive clade of tailed amphibians, and thus are significant in understanding the early evolutionary history of salamanders. However, no consensus has been reached in regard to the origin, evolutionary history of certain characters and phylogenetic relationships of this clade, due to the factors as below: poor fossil records, insufficiency of morphological investigations of living taxa, inconsistency of cladistic analyses using molecular data, and lacking of morphology-based cladistic analyses. Individuals of Batrachuperus londongensis inhabit in the Longdong River area in Mount Emei, Sichuan Province, China, featuring as the single living hynobiid species that is facultatively neotenic, of which certain adults fail to metamorphose but retain larval features. No thorough osteological investigations were conducted, despite that the species has been known to scientific community for 40 years. In this study, the holotype (CIB 14380) of B. londongensis was μCT scanned section by section, via the Quantum GX microCT Imaging System at Chengdu Institute of Biology, Chinese Academy of Sciences. The voxel size derived from these scans ranges between 67.1–144 μm. Several distinctive osteological traits characterizing the neotenic individuals of B. londongensis were revealed, such as the high ossification extent of the hyobranchial apparatus and the complete ossification of carpals and tarsals in the limb. This study represents the first attempt of applying μCT scan techniques in the osteological research in endemic hynobiids of China. This dataset includes the μCT source data of the holotype and the associated parameter files, reconstructed images, videos, 3D pdf and 3D printable stl files of the cranial part of the holotype. All files created from the μCT scan display a clear outline of the skeleton and can be easily employed by software, like VG Studio, etc. Sharing of these files benefits researchers the source data for comparative studies and is valuable for investigating the morphology of endemic hynobiids of China.

titleZh: 2005–2015年中亚热带常绿阔叶林凋落物回收量和现存量月动态数据集
titleEn: A dataset of litter recovery amount and standing crop dynamics in middle subtropical broad-leaved evergreen forests (2005–2015)
introductionZh: 常绿阔叶林是亚热带地区森林中最为稳定的顶级演替群落。通过对湖南会同森林生态系统国家野外科学观测研究站（简称会同站）综合观测场凋落物的长期监测，本数据集整理了2005–2015年中亚热带地区常绿阔叶林凋落物的月回收量和月现存量，具体包括枯枝、枯叶、落果(花)、树皮、苔藓地衣及杂物的干重。本数据集的建立和共享主要为全球变化背景下常绿阔叶林凋落物动态研究提供数据支持，为深入了解中亚热带地区常绿阔叶林生态系统的结构和功能，推动中亚热带地区常绿阔叶林研究长期生态学研究具有重要意义。
introductionEn: The evergreen broad-leaved forest is the most stable top succession community in the subtropical area. Based on a long-time litter observation on the comprehensive observation field by Huitong National Forest Ecosystem Research Station, Hunan (Huitong Station). The dataset integrated monthly litter recovery amount and monthly litter standing crop of the middle subtropical broad-leaved evergreen forests in Huitong Station in the period of 2005-2015, which both comprised branch, leaf, flower and fruit, bark, moss and lichen and other things specifically. The setup and data sharing of the database would offer data supports for litter dynamic study of this forest type in the background of global climate change as well as further understand the structure and function of the evergreen broad-leaved forest ecosystem in the middle subtropical region. Additionally, it could also promote the long-term ecological research of the evergreen broad-leaved forest in the middle subtropical region.

titleZh: 科学大数据管理技术、系统与服务
titleEn: Technology, systems and services of scientific big data management
introductionZh: 2021年10月11日，第七届中国科学数据大会在内蒙古自治区呼和浩特市召开。本报告为周园春研究员在会议作的大会报告。报告主要分析了科学大数据主要特点及需求，重点介绍了高吞吐科学大数据流水线技术与系统、大规模多元异构科学数据的融合管理技术与系统、支持学科领域的大数据管理与处理、科学数据出版与共享等多方面实践，最后从开放共享与数据安全、科学数据软件的自主与引领、支持新范式下的科研创新等方面展开对未来发展的思考。
introductionEn: This report was released at the "The 7th China Scientific Data Conference" on October 11, 2021. This is the conference report delivered by Prof. Zhou Yuanchun at this conference. The report mainly analyzes the main characteristics and requirements of scientific big data, and focuses on the high-throughput scientific big data pipeline technology and system, the fusion management technology and system of large-scale multivariate and heterogeneous scientific data, the big data management and processing in supporting disciplines, scientific data publishing & sharing and other practices. Finally, this report discusses the future development from the following aspects：open sharing and data security, independence and leadership of scientific data software, and it supports for scientific research innovation under the new paradigm.

titleZh: 秦岭山地和关中平原交汇处大气中粉尘元素数据集（2022–2023一年期）
titleEn: Atmospheric Dust Element Dataset at the Qinling Mountains–Guanzhong Plain Interface (One-Year Period: 2022–2023)
introductionZh: 粉尘元素是大气颗粒物无机元素中的主要成分，其在大气中的悬浮与扩散对气候环境、人类健康和生态系统有着深远影响。关中平原和秦岭山地交界处的粉尘元素来源复杂，既有关中土壤侵蚀，也有秦岭岩石风化，还叠加人为扬尘。为厘清平原（关中）-山地（秦岭）交界处粉尘元素组成、来源及分布特点，本研究在平原山地过渡地带的陕西关中平原区域生态环境变化与综合治理国家野外科学观测研究站利用AMMS-100大气重金属分析仪获取小时分辨率大气环境中的粉尘元素浓度，观测仪器定期进行维护、检测、校准和标定以保证仪器的采集数据质量。现将2022年10月至2023年10月的粉尘元素数据以小时尺度公开，其中包括Al、Si、Ca、Fe、Ti、Ba、K等共计7个指标，旨在揭示山地-平原区域粉尘元素的“自然-人为”交互作用，为大气污染防治和生态环境保护提供科学依据。
introductionEn: Dust elements represent the principal inorganic constituents present in atmospheric particulate matter, and their suspension and dispersion in the atmosphere have substantial implications for climate, human health, and ecological systems. The sources of these dust elements at the interface of the Guanzhong Plain and the Qinling Mountains are complex, involving soil erosion in the Guanzhong area, rock weathering processes in the Qinling Mountains, and additional contributions from anthropogenic dust. To investigate the composition, sources, and distribution characteristics of dust elements at the boundary between the plain and the mountains, a dataset was compiled using the AMMS-100 atmospheric heavy metal analyzer located at the National Observation and Research Station of Regional Ecological Environment Change and Comprehensive Management in the Guanzhong Plain, specifically within the transitional zone between the plain and the mountains. The analyzer is subject to regular maintenance, testing, calibration, and standardization to ensure the reliability of the data collected. The dataset, which includes dust element data from October 2022 to October 2023, is now publicly available at an hourly resolution and comprises seven indicators: Al, Si, Ca, Fe, Ti, Ba, and K. This research seeks to clarify the interactions between natural and anthropogenic sources of dust elements in the mountain-plain region, thereby providing a scientific basis for the development of strategies aimed at mitigating air pollution and conserving the ecological environment.

titleZh: 2000–2019年中国海外电力项目信息数据集
titleEn: A dataset of China’s overseas power projects (2000–2019)
introductionZh: 电力短缺是“一带一路”区域广大发展中国家面临的问题之一。自“一带一路”倡议提出以来，中国企业在“一带一路”沿线电力短缺的国家和地区投资、建设了大量的电力项目，由于项目数量多，分布范围广泛，并且每年会不断增加新的电力项目，将形成大量的项目信息，亟需将“一带一路”海外电力项目信息进行收集汇总。本文利用网络爬虫的方法获取海外电力项目的信息，同时通过部委、使馆、经济商务部参赞机构文件、中文英文的当地新闻报道、学者和非政府组织进行的案例研究和实地研究中对项目信息进行进一步补充和完善，形成了“一带一路”海外电力项目数据集。数据集包括来自亚洲、非洲、欧洲、美洲、大洋洲80个国家的376个电力项目，每个项目信息包括项目编号、项目状态、央企集团、二级单位、项目名称、装机容量、所属地区、所在国家、项目类型、中标信息。数据集的收集和完善有助于了解“一带一路”海外电力项目的分布分局，以及近年来的海外电力投资建设发展态势，可为我国电力企业“走出去”提供依据，为“一带一路”海外电力项目发展规划、政府部门决策提供参考。
introductionEn: Power shortages are faced by developing countries in the Belt and Road region. Since the Belt and Road initiative was put forward, Chinese companies have invested and built a large number of electrical power projects in countries and areas with power shortages in this region. Due to the large number and wide distribution of projects and continuous increases in the number of new power projects, a large amount of project information has been generated. Accordingly, it is urgent to collect and summarize One Belt and One Road overseas power project information. In this study, web crawler technology was used to obtain overseas power project information. A One Belt and One Road dataset of overseas power projects was formed by further supplementing and improving the project information using documents from ministries, embassies, counselors of the ministry of economy and commerce, local news reports in Chinese and English, and case studies and field studies conducted by scholars and non-governmental organizations. The dataset includes information on 376 power projects from 80 countries in Asia, Africa, Europe, America, and Oceania. Each project’s information includes the project number, project name, construction status, enterprise name, installed capacity, continent, country, project category, and bid information. The collection and improvement of this dataset will help with understanding the distribution of One Belt, One Road overseas power projects, as well as development trends in overseas power investment and construction in recent years. This can provide a basis for China’s power companies to “go global” and become “One Belt, One Road” overseas. It also provides a reference for power project development planning and government department decision-making.

titleEn: A dataset on multifaceted interactions between urban humans and biodiversity-related concepts in Vietnam

titleZh: 中国物种——污染物负荷数据集
titleEn: A dataset of multi-pollutants in multi-species in China
introductionZh: 污染物在多种生物体内被广泛检出，并对生物多样性构成巨大威胁。揭示野生动物的污染物暴露情况是评估环境污染对生物体的真实风险的基础。本数据库从310篇文献中收集了不同物种中多种化学污染物的含量。数据集由四个文件组成，分别提供了污染物浓度、物种、污染物和数据源信息。共有55297条生物体内污染物含量记录，并有详细的采样时间和地点，目前仍在更新中。通过该数据集，可以全面了解中国各类生物体内污染物的含量，有助于评估环境污染对物种生存乃至生物多样性的风险。
introductionEn: Pollutants are widely detected across a wide range of organisms and pose a great threat to the biodiversity. Revealing the chemical exposome of wildlife is fundamental to assess the real risk of environmental pollution to organisms. This database compiled the levels of multi-chemical pollutants in multi-species from 310 literatures. The database is comprised of four files which provide concentrations of pollutant, species, pollutants, and the data source, respectively. A total of 55297 records on the levels of pollutants in organisms with detailed sampling time and location are available and are still being updated. 559 pollutants detected in 778 species distributed with detailed location across China within these 20 years is included in the database. This database provides a comprehensive understanding of the pollutant contents in various organisms across China. It can facilitate the understanding on the chemical exposome of wildlife and help to assess the risk of environmental pollution on the species survival and thus biodiversity.

titleZh: A dataset of physiological parameters and 13 plant endogenous hormone concentrations with root restriction in 2019-2020
titleEn: A dataset of physiological parameters and 13 plant endogenous hormone concentrations with root restriction in 2019-2020
introductionZh: Root restriction, as an efficient cultivation method, has been widely used to promote grapes fruit quality. In China, root restriction cultivation is usually implemented in the production of table grape berries to get higher yield planting in hot and humid environment. It is well known that endogenous plant hormones play an important role in plant growth and development, flowering and ripening, but the effect of root restriction on endogenous plant hormone contents in grape is still unclear. Therefore, it is very important to build a database of grape endogenous hormone contents with root restriction treatment. These data not only provide a reference for the analysis of fruit quality under root restriction, but also lay a theoretical foundation for the variation tendency of grape endogenous hormone contents. In this study, a total of 84 samples (3 biological replicates) were collected from different tissues and organs in different developmental stages of ‘Muscat Hamburg’ grape and analyzed by high performance liquid chromatography (HPLC). Thirteen endogenous plant hormones were identified and a comprehensive dataset of endogenous plant hormones in different organs and developmental stages of ‘Muscat Hamburg’ grape was established. The results provided data support for rapid detection and quantitative analysis of endogenous plant hormones in grape under root restriction cultivation.

titleZh: 中国七大试点碳市场2014–2017年交易信息数据集
titleEn: A dataset for the trade information during 2014 – 2017 of seven pilot carbon markets in China
introductionZh: 在碳排放权交易市场中，研究市场交易信息有助于了解碳价格形成过程中存在的信息披露和信息传输等问题。本数据集对上海、北京、广东、深圳、湖北、天津和重庆等七个试点碳市场2014-2017年期间的成交数据进行收集，数据主要来源于各试点官方网站公布的信息。为了保证数据的连续性，数据采集过程中剔除了所有无交易的日期。本数据集包含各试点碳市场配额日成交量和日成交额等较全面的交易信息，为开展碳市场量价关系分析与有效性研究等相关工作提供数据支持，也可以为全国碳市场的建设总结相关经验与借鉴。
introductionEn: In the carbon market, the research on trade information is conducive to understanding the problems of information disclosure and information transmission in the formation of carbon price. The trading data during 2014 – 2017 of Shanghai, Beijing, Guangdong, Shenzhen, Hubei, Tianjin and Chongqing were collected from the official websites of seven pilot markets. To ensure the continuity of data, all non-trade dates were removed during the data collection process. This dataset contains comprehensive trade information such as daily transaction volume and daily transaction turnover of each pilot market. It can not only serve as data support for relevant researches such as the analysis of the relationship between volume and price and the research on the effectiveness of carbon market, but also provide experience and reference for the construction of the carbon market nationwide.

titleZh: 基于Sentienl-1、GF-3号卫星多源雷达影像的2020年7月-8月鄱阳湖流域性洪水淹没历时空间分布数据集
titleEn: Spatial distribution of flood duration in Poyang Lake from July to August 2020
introductionZh: 2020年7月，受长江上游来水及江西省境内大面积致灾暴雨影响，鄱阳湖流域的平均水位不断升高，至7月6日2时，鄱阳湖湖口水文站水位涨至警戒水位19.50米，达到洪水编号标准，“鄱阳湖2020年第一号洪水”形成。本数据集基于鄱阳湖2020年洪水的长时序监测，获取多源密集时相的遥感数据为依据，构建此次鄱阳湖流域性洪水期间不同地区的淹没历时空间分布模型，为此次流域性洪水的防灾减灾工作提供科学支撑和理论依据。
introductionEn: In July 2020, affected by incoming water from the upper reaches of the Yangtze River and large-scale torrential rain in Jiangxi Province, the average water level of Poyang Lake basin kept rising. By 2 o 'clock on July 6, the water level of the hydrological station at the mouth of Poyang Lake rose to the warning level of 19.50 meters, reaching the flood numbering standard, and "The First flood of Poyang Lake in 2020" was formed. Based on the long-term monitoring of poyang Lake flood in 2020 and the acquisition of multi-source intensive time phase remote sensing data, this dataset constructed the spatial distribution model of subduction duration in different areas during the flood in poyang Lake region, providing scientific support and theoretical basis for the disaster prevention and mitigation of the flood in Poyang Lake region.

titleZh: 2000-2020年丹江口水库（河南部分）地表水体空间数据集
titleEn: A spatial dataset of the Danjiangkou Reservoir (Henan province) surface water during 2000-2020
introductionZh: 丹江口水库是南水北调工程的水源地。利用遥感图像监测水库地表水的长期变化，对于保证南水北调调水量具有重要意义。在这项研究中，利用多时态地卫星遥感图像，通过修改后的标准化差分水指数（mNDWI）、增强植被指数（EVI）和标准化差异植被指数（NDVI）之间的关系，利用谷歌地球引擎云平台为丹江口水库（河南省）获取长期系列的空间地表水数据集。本数据集包括丹江口水库2000年至2020年21年空间地表水数据集，为研究丹江口水库地表水的时间和空间变化提供了依据。该数据集也可以用作研究该地区气候变化和生态环境变化的基本数据。
introductionEn: The Danjiangkou Reservoir is the water source of the South-to-North Water Diversion Project. The use of remote sensing images to monitor the long-term changes of surface water for the reservoir is of great significance for ensuring the water transfer volume of the South-to-North Water Diversion. In this study, multi-temporal Landsat remote sensing image was used to obtain a long-time series of spatial surface water dataset for the Danjiangkou reservoir (Henan province) based on Google Earth engine cloud platform through the relationship among modified Normalized Difference Water Index (mNDWI), Enhanced Vegetation Index (EVI) and Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI). This dataset includes the 21-years spatial surface water dataset of Danjiangkou Reservoir from 2000 to 2020, which can provide a basis for studying Danjiangkou Reservoir's surface water temporal and spatial changes. The dataset can be used as basic data for the study of climate change and ecological environment changes in the region too.

titleZh: 2000–2020年30 m分辨率中国沙漠沙丘形态数据集
titleEn: A dataset of dune morphology in China’s deserts at 30m resolution from 2000 to 2020
introductionZh: 沙丘形态的分类和识别在许多领域都有着十分重要的作用。通过对沙丘形态的评估, 可以监测沙丘的移动速度和方向, 规划土地利用和基础设施建设, 以及制定有效的防风固沙措施等。本数据集选择2000–2020年的Landsat5 TM、Landsat7 ETM+和Landsat8 OLI遥感影像, 采用深度学习的方法制备了2000–2020年每5年共5期的中国八大沙漠沙丘形态数据集, 数据空间分辨率为 30?m,  数据量为381 MB, 数据格式为*.tif。模型训练完成后测试集的准确率和MIoU分别为89.66%和82.29%, 整体效果良好。本数据集为中国地区沙丘分类方法提供了基础数据, 可用于评估沙漠化的动态过程, 帮助识别沙漠化扩展或逆转的区域, 能扩展遥感解译技术在生态监测中的应用。
introductionEn: The classification and recognition of dune morphology play a vital role in many fields. Assessing dune morphology enabling monitoring the movement speed and direction of dunes, planning land use and infrastructure development, and formulating effective measures for wind prevention and sand fixation. This dataset utilizes Landsat 5 TM, Landsat 7 ETM+, and Landsat 8 OLI remote sensing images from 2000 to 2020 to generate a dataset of dune morphology for the eight major deserts in China, spanning five periods at five-year intervals. The dataset features a spatial resolution of 30 meters, occupies 381 MB of storage, and is stored in *.tif format. The model attained 89.66% accuracy and 82.29% MIoU on the test set, indicating satisfactory performance results. This dataset provides fundamental data for dune classification in China, facilitating the assessment of desertification dynamics and aiding in identifying regions undergoing desertification expansion or reversal. It also broadens the application of remote sensing interpretation technologies in ecological monitoring.

titleZh: 联机手写藏文字符数据集
titleEn: A Dataset of Online Handwritten Tibetan Character
introductionZh: 大规模手写字符数据集对设计和评价手写识别算法和系统的性能非常重要。联机手写藏文字符数据集包括150个书写者数据，每个书写者完成583个藏文字符的书写。583个藏文字符从藏文编码基本集和扩A集中选择，书写者采用电子笔在手写板获得手写藏文字符轨迹点序列。采用已有的识别算法对该数据集进行评价作为实验基准，实验结果表明取得较高识别性能面临大挑战。本数据集预期能够为联机手写藏文输入法中的藏文字符识别算法提供数据支撑。
introductionEn: Large handwritten character data set on the design and evaluation of handwriting recognition algorithms and system performance is very important. On-line handwritten Tibetan characters data set includes 150 written data, each write complete 583 Tibetan characters written. 583 Tibetan coded characters from the basic set and expand a selected writer using the electronic pen tablet obtain handwritten Tibetan characters trajectory sequences. Existing recognition algorithm is used to evaluate the data set as an experimental base, and experimental results that achieve high performance face major challenges. The DataSet is expected for on-line handwritten Tibetan input method for Tibetan character recognition algorithm to provide data.

titleZh: 2022年强高温期长江中游通江湖泊干旱数据集
titleEn: A dataset of Yangtze River-connected arid Lake in the Middle Reaches of Yangtze River during extreme high-temperature in 2022
introductionZh: 全球气候变暖趋势下，2022年夏季，我国长江流域受气候异常影响，出现自1961年有完整气象观测记录以来的最强高温过程，导致长江支流水位持续走低，受气候影响明显的长江中游通江湖泊鄱阳湖、洞庭湖出现了“汛期反枯”的罕见现象。湖泊是全球气候变化的指示器，湖泊水体面积变化成为区域生态环境和气候变化的敏感指标之一。本研究利用GEE云计算平台调用Sentienl-1 SAR数据计算双极化水体指数SDWI，通过OTSU算法计算最佳阈值，获得了2022年强高温期间长江中游鄱阳湖、洞庭湖主体及周边地区10 m分辨率的水体变化监测数据。经过验证，本数据集的总体精度可达96%以上。该数据集包含2022年强高温期间长江中下游主要水体的干旱时空变化信息，可为极端天气湖泊水资源可持续利用等研究提供数据支撑，也为全球气候变化与湖泊生态演化等研究提供数据支撑与科学依据。
introductionEn: As global warming and climate change, in the summer of 2022, the Yangtze River basin in China was affected by climate anomalies and experienced the strongest high-temperature process since the complete meteorological observation records in 1961, which led to the continuous low water level of the Yangtze River tributaries and the rare phenomenon of "anti-depletion of flood season" in Poyang Lake and Dongting Lake, which were affected by climate. Lakes are indicators of global climate change, and water area changes in lakes have become one of the sensitive indicators of regional ecological environment and climate change. In this study, the GEE cloud computing platform was used to call Sentienl-1 SAR data to calculate the sentinel-1 dual-polarized water index(SDWI), and the optimal threshold value was calculated by the OTSU algorithm. The final water change monitoring data at 10m resolution for the main body of Poyang Lake, Dongting Lake and surrounding areas during the strong heat period in 2022 were obtained. This dataset is validated to have an overall accuracy of over 96% and a Kappa coefficient of 0.92. The dataset includes spatiotemporal variations in arid water bodies of the middle and lower reaches of the Yangtze River during strong high temperatures in 2022, which can provide data support and scientific basis for sustainable utilization of lake water resources in extreme weather and global climate change research and ecological evolution of lakes studies.

titleZh: 1990～2003年工程塑料数据库
titleEn: Engineering database
introductionZh: 为了满足用户对工程塑料数据的检索与使用的便利，开发了有多种检索入口的网络版工程塑料数据库。这个数据库的开发能满足塑料工业的发展需求,为塑料制品和模具设计提供省时、有效和正确的选材途径。同时，由于系统采用网络版的形式，充分提高了资源共享程度，使用户均可利用浏览器进行浏览和使用。
introductionEn: To ease the customer experience during the retrieval for engineering plastics database, we develop an web edition for engineering plastics database with multiple retrieval entrance. The database is able to provide a correct, time saving & effective channel during material selection phase for plastics products and mold design, as well as meeting the plastics industry develop requirement. Meanwhile, as the web edition enable the resource sharing, the user can easily navigate the database via windows browser anytime they need.

titleZh: 水稻胡麻斑病图库数据集
titleEn: Rice brown spot dataset
introductionZh: 水稻胡麻斑病。水稻胡麻斑病在中国各稻区均有发生，主要危害水稻。从秧苗期至收获期均可发病，稻株地上部均可受害，以叶片为多。叶片受害后初为小褐点，后扩大为椭圆形褐色病斑，因大小似胡麻籽，故称之为胡麻斑病。病斑边缘明显，外围常有黄色晕圈，后期病斑中央呈灰黄或灰白色。严重时病斑密生，常相联合，形成不规则大斑。谷粒上病斑与叶片上病斑相似，可扩展至全谷粒，湿度大时内外颖合缝处及谷粒表面产生大量黑色绒毛状霉层。穗颈和枝梗受害，症状与稻瘟病相似，但病部呈深褐色，变色部较长。此病易与稻瘟病相混淆，其病斑的两端无坏死线，是与稻瘟病的重要区别。[防治方法]{防治方法}。[种子处理]用40％克瘟散乳剂或50％多菌灵可湿性粉剂1000倍液浸种2天。[农业防治]发病田块的稻草不能直接还田。加强肥料管理，做到基肥足，追肥早，有机肥与磷、钾肥配合施用，尤其是缺钾田块要增施钾肥。前期浅水勤灌，适时适度烤田，后期干湿交替，使稻苗活熟到老。[药剂防治]苗期，用稻瘟灵（春雷霉素）防治。移栽后，用稻瘟灵（春雷霉素）+三环唑结合防治螟虫一起喷雾。
introductionEn: Rice flax spot. Rice flax leaf spot occurs in all rice regions of China, which mainly endangers rice. From seedling stage to harvest stage, the disease can occur, and the above-ground parts of rice plants can be damaged, mostly leaves. Leaf damage was initially small brown spot, then expanded to oval brown spot. Because of the size of flaxseed, it was called flaxseed spot. The edge of the lesion is obvious, and there are often yellow halos around it. The center of the lesion is gray-yellow or gray-white in the later stage. In severe cases, the lesions are dense and often combined to form large irregular spots. The lesions on grains are similar to those on leaves, and can be extended to whole grains. When the humidity is high, a large number of black villous mildew layers are produced on the glume joints and the surface of grains. The symptoms of panicle neck and branch injury were similar to rice blast, but the diseased part was dark brown and the discolored part was longer. The disease is easily confused with rice blast, and there is no necrotic line at both ends of the lesion, which is an important difference from rice blast. [Control methods] {Control methods}. [Seed treatment] Soak seeds in 1000 times liquid of 40% Kewensan Emulsion or 50% Carbendazim Wettable Powder for 2 days. [Agricultural control] The straw in the diseased field can not be returned directly to the field. Strengthen fertilizer management, achieve sufficient base fertilizer, early topdressing, organic fertilizer and phosphorus, potassium fertilizer combined application, especially in potassium-deficient fields to increase the application of potassium fertilizer. Early shallow water irrigation, timely and moderate roasting field, later dry-wet alternation, so that rice seedlings mature to old. [Pharmaceutical control] At seedling stage, rice blast Ling (Chunlaimycin) was used to control the disease. After transplanting, the rice sprout was sprayed together with the combination of trichoderin and Tricyclazole.

titleZh: 三峡库区白家包滑坡观测数据集（2017-2024年）
titleEn: Three Gorges Reservoir Area Baijiabao Landslide Observation Dataset (2017-2024)
introductionZh: 水库蓄水及运行会诱发滑坡地质灾害，水库滑坡的变形演化与库水位升降具有相关性，库水位下降诱发滑坡变形在水库区滑坡地质灾害中具有代表性，表现为库水位下降诱发滑坡变形，并表现为不同的变形演化特性。白家包滑坡是三峡水库蓄水以来变形最为强烈的滑坡之一，并具有阶跃型变形特性，其变形演化特性与库水位下降速率具有强相关性，即库水位下降速率越快，滑坡变形越大。针对水库滑坡研究中长序列观测数据较少的不足，研究团队开展了水库滑坡的长期稳定原位观测。本文整理了三峡库区白家包滑坡自2017年以来滑坡变形与库水位变化的相关数据，主要包括地表GNSS自动观测数据和人工观测数据、地表裂缝观测数据、库水位变化数据和降雨数据。本数据集能够为水库滑坡变形演化规律、滑坡预警、预测评价、工程治理技术方法优选以及滑坡稳定性理论发展和完善提供数据支撑。
introductionEn: Reservoir water storage and operation can induce geological disasters such as landslides. The deformation evolution of reservoir landslides is correlated with the rise and fall of reservoir water levels. The deformation induced by the decline of reservoir water levels is representative of landslide geological disasters in reservoir areas, manifested as landslide deformation induced by the decline of reservoir water levels, and exhibiting different deformation evolution characteristics. The Baijiabao landslide is one of the most strongly deformed landslides in the Three Gorges Reservoir since its impoundment, and has a step like deformation characteristic. Its deformation evolution characteristics are strongly correlated with the rate of water level drop in the reservoir, that is, the faster the rate of water level drop in the reservoir, the greater the deformation of the landslide. In response to the lack of long-term observation data in the study of reservoir landslides, the research team conducted long-term stable in-situ observations of reservoir landslides. This article compiles relevant data on the deformation of the Baijiabao landslide in the Three Gorges Reservoir area since 2017, including surface GNSS automatic observation data and manual observation data, surface crack observation data, reservoir water level change data, and rainfall data. This dataset can provide data support for the evolution law of reservoir landslide deformation, landslide warning, prediction and evaluation, optimization of engineering treatment technology methods, and the development and improvement of landslide stability theory.

titleZh: 共享社会经济路径（SSPs）人口和经济格点化数据库
titleEn: Gridded datasets for population and economy under Shared Socioeconomic  Pathways
introductionZh:
共享社会经济路径（SSPs）全球框架下，根据本地化人口和经济参数，采用人口-发展-环境（PDE）模型，构建了2020-2100年SSPs人口格点数据；采用柯布-道格拉斯（Cobb-Douglas）模型，构建了2020-2100年SSPs经济数据。

数据包括：

全球、一带一路地区、中国区域的人口格点数据，空间分辨率0.5°

全球、一带一路地区、中国区域的GDP格点数据，空间分辨率0.5°

中国区域的三次产业产值格点数据，空间分辨率0.1°
introductionEn:
Under the Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (SSPs) global framework, the Population-Development-Environment (PDE) model and Cobb-Douglas production model with localized population and economic parameters are used to develop the gridded SSPs-population and economic data from 2020 to 2100. The datasets include:

Global, the Belt and Road region, China gridded population data, spatial resolution 0.5 °

Global, the Belt and Road region, China gridded GDP data, spatial resolution 0.5 °

China gridded value-added of primary, secondary and tertiary industries, spatial resolution 0.1 °

titleZh: 南京大学岩石教学薄片显微图像数据集
titleEn: Photomicrograph dataset of rocks for petrology teaching in Nanjing University
introductionZh: 南京大学岩石学教学与研究有百年历史。岩石教学薄片在地质学人才培养中发挥了重要作用。这些岩石学教学薄片在损耗、遗失、补充、更新等过程中形成了目前这一批相对完善的薄片体系，包含了28种沉积岩、40种火成岩、42种变质岩，涵盖了三大类岩石中90%以上的常见岩石类型，囊括了95%以上地质学专业要求掌握的常见矿物类型、岩石结构等教学大纲。本数据集通过系统拍照、信息整理等方式将南京大学岩矿教研室师生们正在使用的岩石教学薄片进行电子信息化，一共完成110种岩石330个岩石薄片的2658张偏光显微照片的电子信息化。为更好地共享这些岩石学的教学素材，特将这些教学薄片的显微照片和教学薄片信息与国内外同行们共享，以便老师们在线上、线下教学中使用，或者方便学生们在线上开展专业进修与自学。此外，这批统一标准的高质量图像数据可以用于机器学习、岩石自动鉴定等交叉研究，也可以在生产实践中作为广告宣传、花样设计的素材。
introductionEn: Thin sections have always played an irreplaceable role in the nearly 100-year history of petrology teaching and research in the School of Earth Sciences and Engineering, Nanjing University. Though these thin sections for teaching have gone through the process of depletion, loss, adding, and renewal, they include 28 different kinds of sedimentary rocks, 40 kinds of igneous rocks, and 42 kinds of metamorphic rocks. These thin sections in Nanjing University cover over 90% of the common types of rocks, including more than 95% of the common minerals and rock textures required by the syllabus of geology major. This dataset electronically informatizes the thin sections currently used by Nanjing University for petrology teaching here. A total of 2658 polarized-light micrographs from 330 thin sections of 110 different kinds of rocks have been completed. In order to better share the teaching materials of petrology, the photomicrographs and information tables of these thin sections are shared with peers. Teachers can use them for teaching, or students can do some professional training and self-study through the dataset. In addition, these high-quality image data with uniform standards can be used for cross-researches such as machine learning and automatic identification of rocks. These photomicrographs can also be used as materials for advertising and pattern design in production practice.

titleZh: A bimodal burst energy distribution of a repeating fast radio burst source
titleEn: A bimodal burst energy distribution of a repeating fast radio burst source
introductionZh:
A bimodal burst energy distribution of a repeating fast radio burst source


We have been carrying out a continuous monitoring campaign of FRB~121102 with the Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical radio Telescope (FAST\cite{li18}) since August 2019. Between August 29 and October 29, 2019, we detected 1652 independent burst events (see Supplementary Table 1) in a total of 59.5 hours, covering 1.05 GHz to 1.45 GHz with 98.304 $\mu$s sampling and 0.122 MHz frequency resolution. The total number of previously published bursts from this source was 347 (http://www.frbcat.org). The flux limit of this burst sample is at least three times lower than those of previous observations. The cadence and depth of the observations allow for a statistical study of the repeating bursts, revealing several previously unseen characteristics. The burst rate peaked at 122/hr on September 7th and then 117/hr on October 1st, both measured over the respective one-hour session. In both instances, the burst rate dropped precipitously afterwards. Burst energies vs. epoch are shown in the lower left and the energy histogram on the right, showing bimodality that is itself a function of epoch.

titleZh: Bias-corrected CMIP6 global dataset for dynamical downscaling of the Earth’s historical and future climate (1979–2100)
titleEn: Bias-corrected CMIP6 global dataset for dynamical downscaling of the Earth’s historical and future climate (1979–2100)
introductionZh: Dynamical downscaling is an important approach to obtaining fine-scale weather and climate information. However, dynamical downscaling simulations are often degraded by biases in the large-scale forcing itself. We constructed a bias-corrected global dataset based on 18 models from the Coupled Model Intercomparison Project Phase 6 (CMIP6) and the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts Reanalysis 5 (ERA5) dataset. The bias-corrected data have an ERA5-based mean climate and interannual variance, but with a non-linear trend from the ensemble mean of the 18 CMIP6 models. The dataset spans the historical time period 1979–2014 and future scenarios (SSP245 and SSP585) for 2015–2100 with a horizontal grid spacing of (1.25° × 1.25°) at six-hourly intervals. Our evaluation suggests that the bias-corrected data are of better quality than the individual CMIP6 models in terms of the climatological mean, interannual variance and extreme events. This dataset will be useful for dynamical downscaling projections of the Earth’s future climate, atmospheric environment, hydrology, agriculture, wind power, etc.

titleZh: 基于GF-3号卫星雷达影像的2021年7月河南省郑州市暴雨洪涝灾害洪水淹没空间分布数据集
titleEn: Spatial distribution data set of flood inundation from rainstorm and flood disasters in Zhengzhou, Henan Province in July 2021
introductionZh: 2021年7月下旬，河南省遭受历史罕见特大暴雨，全省平均过程降雨量达223毫米，多条河流发生超警以上洪水，郑州、新乡、鹤壁等多地遭受特大暴雨洪涝灾害，受灾范围广、灾害损失重、社会关注度高。本数据集基于郑州市7月20日洪涝灾害应急监测，以GF-3雷达遥感数据为依据，获取郑州市暴雨洪涝灾害洪水淹没空间分布数据集，为此次暴雨洪涝灾害的防灾减灾工作提供科学支撑和理论依据。
introductionEn: In late July 2021, Henan Province was hit by a rainstorm rarely seen in history, with an average process rainfall of 223mm. Floods exceeding the alarm level occurred in several rivers, and Zhengzhou, Xinxiang, Hebi and other places were hit by heavy rains and floods. The disaster affected a wide area, caused heavy losses and attracted high social attention. This data set is based on the emergency monitoring of zhengzhou flood disaster on July 20, and based on GF-3 radar remote sensing data, the spatial distribution data set of flood submerging of Zhengzhou rainstorm flood disaster is obtained, which provides scientific support and theoretical basis for the disaster prevention and mitigation work of this rainstorm flood disaster

titleZh: 嫦娥5号月壤颗粒显微中红外反射光谱
titleEn: Micro mid-infrared reflectance spectra of Chang'e-5 lunar soil grains
introductionZh: 此数据集包含有52组显微中红外反射光谱数据，使用的是国家纳米中心的PerkinElmer FTIR Microscope Spotlight 200i光谱仪所测。波数范围为4000-550 cm-1（波长：2.5-18.2 μm），分辨率为1 cm-1. 光束大小为50×50 μm。对于每个样品，我们进行了64次测量，并将其平均值作为最终结果。所有光谱都是在常温常压下测量的，入射和发射天顶角都固定在0度，以金镜作为参考板，得到的是相对于金镜的反射光谱。
introductionEn: The MIR spectra were measured using a PerkinElmer FT-IR Microscope Spotlight 200i spectrometer at the National Center for Nanoscience and Technology in Beijing. The wavenumber range is 4000-550 cm-1 (i.e., 2.5-18.2 μm in wavelength) with a resolution of 1 cm-1. We set a sampling area of  50 by 50 μm to balance the spectral resolution and the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). For each sample, 64 measurements (about 6 minutes) were made and their average is used to ensure a high SNR. All spectra were measured relative to a gold mirror under an ambient environment with both incident and emission zenith angles fixed at zero.

titleZh: 2016–2017年淘宝网受保护鹦鹉和龟类销售数据集
titleEn: A dataset of protected parrots and turtles sold on Taobao in 2016 – 2017
introductionZh: 本数据集由两部分数据组成，其一为受保护鹦鹉的网络销售数据，其二受保护龟类的网络销售数据。数据集共包括2个Excel文件，分别为：DATA_PARROT.xlsx和DATA_TURTLE.xlsx, 其中：(1) DATA_PARROT.xlsx 内含5个数据表单，分别存放了受保护鹦鹉4轮(每轮为30天交易量)的交易数据和46种鹦鹉在全国100个城市的120天交易数据，该Excel表格的数据量为0.15 MB；(2) DATA_TURTLE.xlsx 包含6个数据表单，分别存放了受保护龟类5轮(每轮为30天交易量)的交易数据和49种龟类在全国109个城市的150天交易数据，该Excel表格的数据量为3.83 MB。
introductionEn: The dataset consists of two parts, one is the online sales data of protected parrots, another is the online sales data of protected turtles. There are thus two files, (1) DATA_PARROT.xlsx has five worksheets, which respectively store the transactions data of parrots for 4 rounds (each round includes 30-days transaction volumes) and a total data of 120-days transaction volumes of 46 parrot species from 100 prefectures in China. It has a size of 0.15 MB. (2) DATA_TURTLE.xlsx contains six worksheets, including the transactions data of turtles for 5 rounds (each round includes 30-days transaction volumes) and a total data of 150-days transaction volumes of 49 turtle species from 109 prefectures in China. It has a size of 3.83 MB.

titleZh: Supplementation of Weizmannia coagulans BC2000 and Ellagic Acid Inhibits High-Fat-Induced Hypercholesterolemia by Promoting Liver Primary Bile Acid Biosynthesis and Intestinal Cholesterol Excretion in Mice
titleEn: Supplementation of Weizmannia coagulans BC2000 and Ellagic Acid Inhibits High-Fat-Induced Hypercholesterolemia by Promoting Liver Primary Bile Acid Biosynthesis and Intestinal Cholesterol Excretion in Mice
introductionZh: The probiotic Weizmannia coagulans (W. coagulans) BC2000 can increase the abundance of intestinal transforming ellagic acid (EA) bacteria and inhibit metabolic disorders caused by hyperlipidemia by activating liver autophagy. This study aimed to investigate the inhibitory effects of W. coagulans BC2000 and EA on hyperlipidemia-induced cholesterol metabolism disorders. C57BL/6J mice (n = 10 in each group) were fed a low-fat diet, high-fat diet (HFD), HFD supplemented with EA, HFD supplemented with EA and W. coagulans BC77, HFD supplemented with EA, and W. coagulans BC2000. EA and W. coagulans BC2000 supplementation prevented HFD-induced hypercholesterolemia and promoted fecal cholesterol excretion. Transcriptome analysis showed that primary bile acid biosynthesis in the liver was significantly activated by EA and W. coagulans BC2000 treatments. EA and W. coagulans BC2000 treatment also significantly increased the intestinal Eggerthellaceae abundance and the liver EA metabolites, iso-urolithin A, Urolithin A, and Urolithin B. Therefore, W. coagulans BC2000 supplementation promoted the intestinal transformation of EA, which led to the upregulation of liver bile synthesis, thus preventing hypercholesterolemia.

titleZh: 小麦叶锈病图库数据集
titleEn: Wheat leaf rust dataset
introductionZh: 小麦叶锈病，又名小麦秆锈病、条锈病。小麦叶锈病主要发生在河北、山西、内蒙古、河南、山东、贵州、云南、黑龙江、吉林。主要为害小麦叶片，产生疱疹状病斑，很少发生在叶鞘及茎秆上。夏孢子堆圆形至长椭圆形，桔红色，比秆锈病小，较条锈病大，呈不规则散生，在初生夏孢子堆周围有时产生数个次生的夏孢子堆，一般多发生在叶片的正面，少数可穿透叶片。成熟后表皮开裂一圈，散出桔黄色的夏孢子；冬孢子堆主要发生在叶片背面和叶鞘上，圆形或长椭圆形，黑色，扁平，排列散乱，但成熟时不破裂。。[防治方法]品种选取：种植抗耐病品种如黄淮海地区种植陕农7859、冀5418、鲁麦1号、小偃6号、徐州21号等冬小麦品种。此外，近年新选育的抗叶锈冬小麦品种有：京冬1号、8号，京核3号（京核931），京411、北农白，皖麦26、27、28号，绵阳26号，百农64，周麦9号-矮优688系，新宝丰（7228），豫麦39（豫农8539），早麦5号，劲松49号，兴麦17号，滇麦19号，秦麦12号，冀麦48、40、冀92-3235、6021新系等；春小麦品种有：垦九5号、龙麦23号、龙辐麦7号、蒙麦30号、京引1号、陇春8139、定丰3号等。[农业防治]加强栽培防病措施 适期播种，消灭杂草和自生麦苗，雨季及时排水，上湿气滞留。[药物防治]药剂拌种用种子重量的0.03%—0.04%（有效成分）叶锈特或用种子重量0.2%的20%三唑酮乳油拌种。提供使用15%保丰1号种衣剂（活性成分为粉锈宁、多菌灵、辛硫磷）包衣种子后自动固化成膜状，播后形成保护圈，且持效期长。用量每kg种子用4g包衣防治小麦叶锈病、白粉病、全蚀病效果优异，且可兼治地下害虫。于发病初期喷洒20%三唑酮乳油1000倍液可兼治条锈病、秆锈病和白粉病，隔10—20天1次，防治1—2次。
introductionEn: Wheat leaf rust, also known as wheat stalk rust, stripe rust. Wheat leaf rust mainly occurs in Hebei, Shanxi, Inner Mongolia, Henan, Shandong, Guizhou, Yunnan, Heilongjiang and Jilin. It mainly damages wheat leaves and produces herpes-like lesions, rarely occurring in leaf sheath and stem. Summer spore heap is round to long ellipse, orange-red, smaller than stem rust, larger than stripe rust, and scattered irregularly. Several secondary summer spore heaps occur around the primary summer spore heap, usually on the front of the leaves, and a few can penetrate the leaves. After maturation, the epidermis cracks in a circle, and the orange summer spores are scattered out. The winter spore heap mainly occurs on the back of leaves and leaf sheaths. It is round or oblong, black, flat and scattered, but it does not break up when it is mature. [Control methods] Variety selection: Resistant and resistant varieties such as Shaannong 7859, Ji5418, Lumai 1, Xiaoyan 6 and Xuzhou 21 were planted in Huanghuaihai region. In addition, in recent years, newly bred Winter Wheat Varieties with leaf rust resistance are: Jingdong 1, 8, Jinghe 3 (Jinghe 931), Jing411, Beinongbai, Wanmai 26, 27, 28, Mianyang 26, Bainong 64, Zhoumai 9-Aiyou 688, Xinbaofeng (7228), Yumai 39 (Yunong 8539), Zaomai 5, Jinsong 49, Xingmai 17, Yunmai 19, Qinmai 12, Jimai 48, 40, Ji 92-3235, 6. New lines 021, etc. Spring wheat varieties are Ken 95, Longmai 23, Longfumai 7, Mengmai 30, Jingyin 1, Longchun 8139, Dingfeng 3, etc. [Agricultural control] Strengthen cultivation and disease prevention measures to sow timely, eliminate weeds and self-growing wheat seedlings, timely drainage in rainy season, retention of humidity. [Drug control] Drug seed dressing with 0.03% - 0.04% (active ingredient) leaf rust or 20% Triazolone EC with 0.2% seed weight. The seeds coated with 15% Baofeng No. 1 seed coating agent (active ingredients are pink rust Ning, carbendazim, phoxim) are automatically solidified into film shape, and a protective ring is formed after sowing, with a long lasting effect. Four grams per kg of seeds were used to control wheat leaf rust, powdery mildew and total rot, and also to control underground pests. Spraying 20% Triazolone EC 1000 times at the initial stage of disease can treat stripe rust, stalk rust and powdery mildew, once every 10-20 days, and prevent 1-2 times.

titleZh: 2017–2018年中国西部冰川编目数据集
titleEn: A dataset of glacier inventory in Western China during 2017–2018
introductionZh: 中国西部冰川区对气候变化响应敏感性强，变化幅度大。自中国第二次冰川编目以来，我国缺乏对中国西部地区冰川的系统性调查。本数据集在中国第二次冰川编目数据基础上，利用315景Landsat遥感影像和SRTM等多种数据源，结合ArcGIS、Google Earth等处理软件，通过人工目视解译，完成了2017–2018年中国西部冰川边界的提取、边界的质量检查、面积的不确定分析和冰川属性的更新。结果显示，2017–2018年中国西部现存冰川53?238条，总面积为47?174.21±19.93 km2，面积误差占冰川总面积的±0.04%。在中国第二次冰川编目未完成的藏东南地区，共有冰川13066条，总面积7611.25±4.64 km2。本数据集为探讨中国西部冰川变化和冰川对气候变化的响应等相关研究提供数据支撑。
introductionEn: The glaciers in Western China are highly sensitive to climate change and change greatly. Since the second glacier inventory in China, there has been a lack of systematic investigation on the glaciers in Western China. Based on the second glacier inventory data, this dataset has completed the extraction of glacier boundaries, quality checking of boundaries, uncertainty analysis of area and updating of glacier attributes in Western China during 2017–2018 through various data sources such as 315 Landsat remote sensing images and SRTM, combined with processing software of ArcGIS and Google Earth, and through manual visual interpretation. The results show that 53,238 glaciers existed in Western China in 2018, with a total area of 47,174.21 ± 19.93 km2, area error of ±0.04% of the total glacier area. In the southeastern Tibetan Plateau where the second glacier inventory in China is not yet completed, there are 13,066 glaciers with a total area of 7611.25±4.64 km2. This dataset provides data support for studies on glacier changes and the response of glaciers to climate change in Western China.

titleZh: 亚洲高山区逐日积雪覆盖度数据集
titleEn: Daily Fractional Snow Cover (FSC) Data set over High Asia
introductionZh: 高亚洲是以青藏高原为主要区域的亚洲高海拔地区，是中低纬度高山积雪的重要分布区，其积雪的动态变化对水和能量平衡及区域气候具有重要的影响。由于青藏高原地区季节性积雪具有赋存时间短、雪层较薄的特点，在对水循环等问题的理解中，迫切需要日时间尺度的积雪覆盖度动态监测。本数据集基于空间分辨率为500 m的MODIS归一化积雪指数数据，结合地形和多种云覆盖下积雪覆盖度估算算法的优势，实现云覆盖条件下的积雪覆盖度再估算，满足高亚洲地区逐日少云（＜10％）数据产品的生产，构建了2002～2018年高亚洲地区MODIS逐日积雪覆盖度数据集。选取无云条件下的二值积雪产品作为参考，通过云量分布和积雪总面积的时空对比，表明该产品的时空特征和二值产品具有较好的一致性。以2013年冬季为例，当积雪覆盖度大于50％时，其相关性可达0.8628。本数据集可为高亚洲地区的积雪动态监测、气候环境、水文和能量平衡、灾害评估等研究提供逐日积雪覆盖度数据。
introductionEn: High Asia is Asian high altitude area with the Tibetan Plateau as the main area, and is also an important distribution area of low and middle latitude mountain snow. The dynamic changes of snow in this area have important effects on water, energy balance and regional climate. As the seasonal snow in the Tibetan Plateau has the characteristics of short storage time and thin snow cover, it is urgent for the understanding of water circulation to monitor the snow cover on day time scales. The dataset is based on MODIS normalized snow index data with the spatial resolution of 500 meters, combing with the terrain data and advantages of a variety of snow cover estimation algorithm under the cloud cover, gradually realizes re-estimation of snow cover under the conditions of cloud cover, meets the need of cloud under 10％ and finally produces “Daily Fractional Snow Cover (FSC) Data set over High Asia (2002–2018)”. Then select binary snow products under cloud free conditions as reference to carry out comparison of cloud distribution and total area time series of two products, the results show that fractional snow cover products accord with binary snow products in both space and time. In the case of the winter of 2013, when the value of fractional snow cover is greater than 50％, the relevance of two products is up to 0.8628. This data set is expected to provide high-temporal-resolution data input for the dynamic monitoring of snow over high Asia and the research of climate environment, hydrological and energy balance and disaster assessment.

titleZh: 水稻稻曲病图库数据集
titleEn: Bacterial blight of rice dataset
introductionZh: 水稻白叶枯病，又名白叶瘟、茅草瘟、地火烧等。水稻白叶枯病是水稻生产上的重要病害之一，是水稻上主要病害之一，是一种检疫性病害。水稻白叶枯病主要为害叶片，引起植株调萎至死亡，对水稻产量影响较大水稻白叶枯病一旦发生，一般可减产10%左右，严重的可减产50-60%，甚至90%。一般籼稻重于粳糯稻，晚稻重于早稻。主要发生于叶片及叶鞘上。初起在叶缘产生半透明黄色小斑，以后沿叶缘一侧或两侧或沿中脉发展成波纹状的黄绿或灰绿色病斑；病部与健部分界线明显；数日后病斑转为灰白色，并向内卷曲，远望一片枯槁色，故称白叶枯病。[防治方法]选用抗病品种为基础，在减少菌源的前提下，狠抓肥水管理，辅以药剂防治，重点抓好秧田期的水浆管理和药剂防治。[种子处理]播前用50倍液的福尔马林浸种3小时，再闷种12小时，洗净后再催芽。也可选用浸种灵乳油2毫升，加水10-12升，充分搅匀后浸稻种6-8千克，浸种36小时后催芽播种。[农业防治]选用抗病品种，是防治白叶枯病最经济有效的途径，如华安2号、中9A/838、皖稻44、金两优36、特优813、优优128等。清理病田稻草残渣，病稻草不直接还田，尽可能防止病稻草上的病原菌传入秧田和本田。搞好秧田管理，培育无病状秧。选好秧田位置，严防淹苗。秧田应选择地势高，无病，排灌方便，远离稻草堆、打谷场和晒场地，连作晚稻秧田还应远离早稻病田。防止串灌、谩灌和长期深水灌溉。防止过多偏施氮肥，还要配施磷、钾肥。[药剂防治]老病区在台风暴雨来临前或过境后，对病田或感病品种立即全面喷药1次，特别是洪涝淹水的田块。用药次数根据病情发展情况和气候条件决定，一般间隔7-10天喷1次，发病早的喷2次，发病迟的喷1次。每667平方米86.2%氧化亚铜水分颗粒剂、杀菌农药【门神】50mL，70%叶枯净（又称杀枯净）胶悬剂100-150克，或25%叶枯宁可湿性粉剂100克，或高科20%氟硅唑咪鲜胺30-50mL，或10%氯霉素可湿性粉剂100克，或50%代森铵100克（抽穗后不能用），或25%消菌灵可湿性粉剂40克，或32%核苷溴吗啉胍（兼防病毒病）600倍液，或15%消菌灵200克，或天威3号（50%氯溴异氰尿酸，登记的是水稻白叶枯病）以上药剂加水50升喷雾。[治虫控病]这是防治持久性虫传病毒病的通用措施，也是当前条纹叶枯病防治上的急救措施，经初步试验表明有较好效果，但如防治不当仍会造成严重危害。治虫时要注意同时连片用药，以确保防治效果。由于灰飞虱传毒过程非常迅速和病毒病本身的特殊性，单一依靠药剂治虫并不能达到100%的效果，最好与抗耐品种结合使用方能达到更好效果。
introductionEn: Rice bacterial leaf blight, also known as white leaf blast, grass blast, ground fire and so on. Rice bacterial blight is one of the important diseases in rice production, one of the main diseases in rice, and a quarantine disease. Rice bacterial leaf blight mainly damages leaves and causes plant wilting to death. Once it occurs, the yield of rice bacterial leaf blight can generally be reduced by about 10%, and the serious yield can be reduced by 50-60%, or even 90%. Generally, indica rice is heavier than japonica glutinous rice, and late rice is heavier than early rice. It mainly occurs in leaves and sheaths. At first, translucent yellow spots appeared on the leaf margin, then developed into ripple yellow-green or grey-green spots along one or both sides of the leaf margin or along the middle vein; the boundary between the disease and the healthy part was obvious; after a few days, the disease spots turned grey-white and curled inward, looking far into a faded color, so it was called bacterial blight. [Control methods] Based on the selection of disease-resistant varieties and on the premise of reducing bacterial sources, we should pay close attention to fertilizer and water management, supplemented by chemical control, focusing on slurry management and chemical control in seedling stage. [Seed treatment] Soak seeds with formalin 50 times liquid for 3 hours before sowing, then stuff seeds for 12 hours, and then germinate after washing. It can also be used to soak rice seeds 6-8 kg after mixing with 2 milliliters of Zaoshiling EC and 10-12 liters of water. After 36 hours of soaking, it can accelerate germination and sowing. [Agricultural control] Selection of disease-resistant varieties is the most economical and effective way to control bacterial blight, such as Huaan 2, Zhong9A/838, Wandao 44, Jinliangyou 36, Teyou 813 and Youyou 128. Clean up the residue of diseased rice straw, diseased rice straw is not directly returned to the field, as far as possible to prevent pathogenic bacteria on diseased rice straw into the rice seedling and Honda. Good management of seedling fields and cultivation of disease-free seedlings. Select the position of seedling field and strictly prevent flooding seedlings. The seedling field should be high, disease-free, easy to drain and irrigate, far away from the straw heap, threshing and drying fields, and the late rice seedling field should also be far away from the early rice disease field. Prevent cross irrigation, straw irrigation and long-term deep water irrigation. To prevent excessive partial application of nitrogen fertilizer, we should also apply phosphorus and potassium fertilizer. [Pharmaceutical control] Before or after the arrival of typhoon rainstorm, the old sick areas sprayed the diseased fields or susceptible varieties once, especially the flooded fields. According to the development of the disease and climatic conditions, the number of medications is usually sprayed once every 7-10 days, twice early onset and once late onset. Every 667 square meters, 86.2% cuprous oxide water granules, sterile pesticides (Menshen) 50 mL, 70% Yekujing (also known as Xikujing) suspension 100-150 g, or 25% Yekuning wettable powder 100 g, or Gaoke 20% fluorosilazole imidazole 30-50 mL, or 10% chloramphenicol wettable powder 100 g, or 50% Daisen ammonium 100 g (not available after heading), or 25% Xiaokulin wettable powder 40 g, or 32% nucleus. Glucoside morphine guanidine (anti viral disease) 600 times liquid, or 15% carbendazim 200 grams, or Print-Rite 3 (50% chlorbromo isocyanuric acid, registered rice leaf blight) above medicament and water 50 liter spray. [Pest control and disease control] This is a general measure to control persistent insect-borne virus disease, and also a first-aid measure to control stripe blight. Preliminary experiments show that it has good effect, but if the control is not proper, it will still cause serious harm. In order to ensure the effect of pest control, we should pay attention to the use of medicines in conjunction with tablets at the same time. Because of the rapid transmission of the virus and the particularity of the virus disease itself, the effect of insecticide treatment alone can not reach 100%. It is better to combine with resistant varieties to achieve better results.

titleZh: 中国北方及黄河流域生态系统有机碳储量时空数据集（1980–2020年）
titleEn: A spatiotemporal dataset of organic carbon storage in ecosystems in northern China and the Yellow River Basin (1980–2020)
introductionZh: 本数据集利用干旱生态系统模型AEM (Arid Ecosystem Model)模拟了中国北方和黄河流域的碳储量，空间分辨率为 10 km×10 km，研究区包括中国北方和黄河流域，分别是新疆维吾尔自治区、西藏自治区、青海省、甘肃省、内蒙古自治区、宁夏回族自治区、辽宁省、黑龙江省、吉林省、河北省、陕西省、山西省、四川省、河南省、山东省和北京市。本研究旨在分析气候变化与大气CO2浓度升高对中国北方干旱半干旱区及黄河流域碳储量的影响，为理解中国北方、黄河流域生态系统的碳循环和制定相应的生态保护策略提供科学依据。数据集包含了总碳库、植被碳库、土壤碳库和凋落物碳库。本数据集的建立和共享，为区域生态系统碳储量评估，生态系统质量评估提供了重要的基础数据。该数据集的发布为深入理解中国北方和黄河流域生态系统的碳循环提供了科学依据，并为生态保护策略的制定提供了支撑，同时助力国家碳预算估算和可持续农业政策的制定。
introductionEn: This dataset uses the Arid Ecosystem Model (AEM) to simulate carbon storage in northern China and the Yellow River Basin with a spatial resolution of 10 km×10 km. The study area includes northern China and the Yellow River Basin, namely Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, Tibet Autonomous Region, Qinghai Province, Gansu Province, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region, Liaoning Province, Heilongjiang Province, Jilin Province, Hebei Province, Shaanxi Province, Shanxi Province Sichuan, Henan Province, Shandong Province and Beijing. This study aims to analyze the impacts of climate change and rising atmospheric CO2 concentrations on carbon storage in the arid and semi-arid regions of northern China and the Yellow River Basin, and provide a scientific basis for understanding the carbon cycle of northern China's ecosystems and formulating corresponding ecological protection strategies. The dataset includes vegetation carbon pool, soil carbon pool and litter carbon pool. The establishment and sharing of this dataset provides important basic data for regional ecosystem carbon storage assessment and ecosystem quality assessment. The publication of this dataset provides a scientific basis for understanding the carbon cycle of northern China and the Yellow River Basin 's ecosystems and supports the formulation of ecological conservation strategies, while also contributing to national carbon budget estimation and sustainable agricultural policy development.

titleZh: Decoding human visual colour EEG information using machine learning and visual evoked potentials
titleEn: Decoding human visual colour EEG information using machine learning and visual evoked potentials
introductionZh: With the rapid development of brain-computer interfaces (BCIs), human visual decoding, one of the important research directions of BCIs, has attracted a substantial amount of attention. However, most visual decoding studies have focused on graphic and image decoding. In this paper, we first demonstrate the possibility of building a new kind of task-irrelevant, simple and fast-stimulus BCI-based experimental paradigm that relies on visual evoked potentials (VEPs) during colour observation. Additionally, the features of visual colour information were found through reliable real-time decoding. We selected 9 subjects who did not have colour blindness to participate in our tests. These subjects were asked to observe red, green, and blue screens in turn with an interstimulus interval of 1 second. The machine learning results showed that the visual colour classification accuracy had a maximum of 93.73%. The latency evoked by visual colour stimuli was within the P300 range, i.e., 176.8 milliseconds for the red screen, 206.5 milliseconds for the green screen, and 225.3 milliseconds for the blue screen. The experimental results hereby show that the VEPs can be used for reliable colour real-time decoding.

titleZh: 中国开放数据白皮书 2023
titleEn: China State of Open Data Report 2023
introductionZh:
本白皮书由中国科学院计算机网络信息中心、Springer Nature、Figshare、科学数据银行（Science Data Bank）、Digital Science联合发布。

中国科学院计算机网络信息中心通过Springer Nature、Figshare和Digital Science发布的State of Open Data，分析了中国科研人员对开放数据的态度和经验。报告还邀请了来自中国多个报告嘉宾，对中国的开放数据政策、实践和前景进行了全面的概述。包括：国家知识产权局、多个国家科学数据中心、数据期刊专家等。

introductionEn:
This white paper is jointly released by Computer Network Information Center of Chinese Academy of Sciences (CNIC), Springer Nature, Figshare, Science Data Bank and Digital Science.

CNIC analyzed Chinese researchers’ attitudes towards and experiences of open data based on the survey for the State of Open Data shared by Springer Nature, Figshare and Digital Science. titleZh: Age- and enthinity-specific brain templates and growth charts for children and adolescents at school age
titleEn: Age- and enthinity-specific brain templates and growth charts for children and adolescents at school age
introductionZh:
Description：
Brain growth charts and age-normed brain templates are essential resources for researchers to eventually contribute to the care of individuals with atypical developmental trajectories. The present work generates age-normed brain templates for children and adolescents at one-year intervals and the corresponding growth charts to investigate the influences of age and ethnicity using a common pediatric neuroimaging protocol. Two accelerated longitudinal cohorts with the identical experimental design were implemented in the United States and China. Anatomical magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of typically developing school-age children (TDC) was obtained up to three times at nominal intervals of 1.25 years. The protocol generated and compared population- and age-specific brain templates and growth charts, respectively. A total of 674 Chinese pediatric MRI scans were obtained from 457 Chinese TDC and 190 American pediatric MRI scans were obtained from 133 American TDC.Population- and age-specific brain templates were used to quantify warp cost, the differences between individual brains and brain templates. Volumetric growth charts for labeled brain network areas were generated. Shape analyses of cost functions supported the necessity of age-specific and ethnicity-matched brain templates, which was confirmed by growth chart analyses. These analyses revealed volumetric growth differences between the two ethnicities primarily in lateral frontal and parietal areas, regions which are most variable across individuals in regard to their structure and function. Age- and ethnicity-specific brain templates facilitate establishing unbiased pediatric brain growth charts, indicating the necessity of the brain charts and brain templates generated in tandem. These templates and growth charts as well as related codes have been made freely available to the public for open neuroscience
Usage:
The age-specific head brain templates can be used for pediatric neuroimaging studies to provide a standard reference on head brain spaces. Sample codes for such uses can be found on Github(https://github.com/zuoxinian/CCS/tree/master/H3/GrowthCharts). The growth charts on various school-age children and adolescents can provide a normal growth standard on the brain development across school age, together with the normative modeling methods, they offer an analytic way of implementing individualized or personalized pediatrics. All the templates and growth charts are downloadable as NIFTI files. For a given NIFTI file in the dataset, IPCAS indicates the Chinese school age template,NKI named files indicate American template.Users can find the age-specific template in the name of (IPCAS/NKI)_age(X)_brain_template.nii.gz and the different tissue template are also provided by this dataset in the name of （IPCAS/NKI)_age(X)_brain_pve(_0/_1/_2/seg) in which 0 indicates CSF, 1 indicates gray matter, 2 indicates white matter, and seg indicates hard segmentatin.

titleZh: 2017–2022年青藏工程走廊多年冻土区地表InSAR形变监测数据集
titleEn: Two-dimensional ground deformation dataset in permafrost zone of the Qinghai-Tibet Engineering Corridor, China (from February 2017 to March 2022)
introductionZh:
青藏工程走廊地处青藏高原腹地，由东北——西南走向（格尔木到拉萨）全长1120 km，近年来，随着气候变暖和人类活动的加剧，其多年冻土区段（西大滩——安多，约550 km）所面临的多年冻土退化问题非常显著，由此导致了一系列环境地质灾害。地表形变作为环境地质灾害的第一表征，可通过合成孔径雷达干涉测量（InSAR）技术进行大范围、长时序、高精度地测量。基于此，本数据集基于LiCSAR产品结合LiCSBAS工具包获取覆盖工程走廊多年冻土区段的长时序升、降轨LOS向形变结果（时序累积形变量和整个时段的形变速率），然后以SAR影像所获取的日期为条件（相同或相近的）对结果进行筛选，在忽略南北向形变的情况下通过结合SAR卫星几何参数解算出地表垂直向和东西向的形变结果。通过与现场监测的垂直向形变测量结果的对比表明，垂直向结果的误差大多在10 mm内，最大不超过30 mm，而与单一升、降轨的误差多大于30 mm。该数据集不仅可以作为后续相关InSAR形变监测的对比，而且还可以为交通线性工程，如青藏公路、青藏铁路等的正常运营和维护提供数据支撑和有效建议。此外，该数据集还可以作为输入数据用于多年冻土活动层厚度的反演等工作。


数据文件命名方式和使用方法


时序累积形变结果包括Ascending.7z、Descending.7z、UD.7z和EW.7z分别代表升轨LOS向、降轨LOS向、垂直向和东西向的时序累积形变量结果，每个压缩文件内包含51个时期的累积形变量，命名格式依次为asc_YYYYMMDD.tif、dec_YYYYMMDD.tif、ud_YYYYMMDD.tif和ew_YYYYMMDD.tif，其中YYYYMMDD表示时间节点，如20170225。 2017年2月25日至2022年3月31日的形变速率结果包含在Velocity.7z压缩包内，共有4个文件ascending.tif、descending.tif、ew.tif和ud.tif分别表示升轨LOS向、降轨LOS向、东西向和垂直向形变速率结果。 另外，结果展示.pdf文件展示了所有结果的可视化图。
introductionEn:
The Qinghai-Tibet Engineering Corridor, stretching 1120 km from Golmud to Lhasa in the hinterland of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, has experienced significant permafrost degradation in its permafrost section (from Xidatan to Amdo), as a result of climate warming and human activities. This has led to a range of environmental geological hazards, with surface deformation being the first observable sign of such hazards. The synthetic aperture radar interferometry (InSAR) technology provides a quick and efficient means of measuring surface deformation, with its large range, long time series, and high accuracy. To this end, this dataset presents the long time series results of LOS-oriented (line of sight direction) deformation in both the ascending and descending orbits, covering the permafrost section of the engineering corridor. The results were obtained using the LiCSAR product collection, LiCSBAS toolkit, and filtered based on the dates of the SAR images. The surface vertical and east-west deformation results were obtained by combining the SAR satellite geometric parameters, while ignoring the north-south deformation. Comparisons with the vertical deformation measurements obtained in the field show that the errors of the vertical results are mostly within 10 mm, with the maximum error not exceeding 30 mm. However, the error with a single ascending or descending track is more than 30 mm. This dataset not only provides a basis for subsequent InSAR deformation monitoring but also serves as a valuable data resource for the effective operation and maintenance of transportation linear projects such as the Qinghai-Tibet Highway and Qinghai-Tibet Railway. Additionally, the dataset can serve as input data for the inversion of permafrost active layer thickness, among other applications.



How to name and use data files


The time-series cumulative deformation results include Ascending.7z, Descending.7z, UD.7z and EW.7z representing the time-series cumulative deformation results in the ascending LOS direction, descending LOS direction, vertical direction and east-west direction, respectively, and each zip file contains the cumulative deformation results for 51 periods in the naming format asc_YYYYMMDD.tif, dec_YYYYMMDD.tif, ud_YYYYMMDD.tif, and ew_YYYYMMDD.tif, where YYYYMMDD denotes the time node, e.g., 20170225. All types of the deformation rate results from February 25, 2017 to March 31, 2022 are included in the Velocity.7z archive, and there are four files, i.e., ascending.tif, descending.tif, ew.tif, and ud.tif representing the ascending LOS direction, descending LOS direction, east-west direction, and vertical direction deformation rate results, respectively. In addition, the pdf file, i.e., Result plotting.pdf displays a visualization of all related results.

titleZh: 广西山口红树林保护区无人机影像与人工修复典型要素监测数据集（2023–2024年）
titleEn: UAV Imagery and Artificial Restoration Typical Element Monitoring Dataset for the Guangxi Shankou Mangrove Nature Reserve, 2023–2024
introductionZh: 本数据集利用无人机低空摄影测量方法，于2023年11月完成7903公顷英罗港及丹兜海片区正射影像采集与处理，2024年2月、5月完成255.9公顷沙尾片浒苔、马扒栏和荣片浒苔正射影像采集处理，2024年11月完成5623公顷英罗港及丹兜海片区正射影像采集处理。采用的数学基础为2000国家大地坐标系、1985国家高程基准。基于2023年11月航拍处理得到的航摄影像，经过人工目视解译的方法，获取互花米草、浒苔、人工养殖区（蚝排蚝桩）、红树林等监测要素的范围数据作为红树林保护区时空变化的基础数据，从而监测各要素在特定时段的变化情况。为北海滨海湿地生态保护、生态修复情况提供科学有效的数据支撑，为红树林生态系统恢复、保护和管理给予决策参考。
introductionEn: This dataset utilizes unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) low altitude photogrammetry method to complete the acquisition and processing of 7903 hectares of orthophoto images in the Yingluo Port and Dandou Sea area in November 2023, 255.9 hectares of Shaweipian Enteromorpha, Mabilan and Rongpian Enteromorpha orthophoto images in February and May 2024, and 5623 hectares of Yingluo Port and Dandou Sea orthophoto images in November 2024. The mathematical foundation used is the 2000 National Geodetic Coordinate System and the 1985 National Elevation Datum. Based on aerial images processed in November 2023, the range data of monitoring elements such as Spartina alterniflora, Enteromorpha prolifera, artificial aquaculture areas (oyster beds), and mangroves were obtained through manual visual interpretation as the basic data for the spatiotemporal changes of mangrove protected areas, in order to monitor the changes of each element during specific periods. To provide scientific and effective data support for the ecological protection and restoration of Beihai coastal wetlands, and to provide decision-making references for the restoration, protection, and management of mangrove ecosystems.

titleZh: 基于NSGA-II算法的干涉阵列UV覆盖多目标优化仿真数据
titleEn: Simulation data of multi-objective optimization of interferometric Array u–v Coverage based on NSGA-II algorithm
introductionZh: “Multi-objective Optimization of Interferometric Array u–v Coverage”的模拟数据图。 该数据集包括基于 NSGA-II算法得到的Pareto最优解集，Pareto最优集中多种不同阵列排布的性能评估和排序结果，以及从 Pareto 最优解集中选出的最佳阵列的相关性能。多种不同阵列排布的性能评估和排序结果由理想解法获得。最佳阵列的性能展示包括瞬时UV覆盖、地球旋转综合模式下的UV覆盖以及综合波束。该数据集基于matlab仿真得到，可用于阵列排布的多目标优化研究。
introductionEn: Simulation data of "Multi-objective Optimization of Interferometric Array u–v Coverage." The database includes the Pareto optimal set derived based on NSGA-II, performance evaluation and ranking results of many different array configurations in the Pareto optimal set, and features of the final optimal array selected from the Pareto optimal set. The data of performance evaluation and ranking of arrays were obtained by a method called Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution. Features of the final optimal are included snapshot u–v distribution, u–v distribution in Earth rotation synthesis mode, and synthesized beam. We present the simulation results of our data using Matlab. Moreover, the dataset can be used for the study of multi-objective optimization of the array configuration.

titleZh: 基于时序InSAR技术的G109青藏公路地质隐患识别数据集
titleEn: Dataset for Geological Hazard Identification along the G109 Qinghai-Tibet Highway based on Time-Series InSAR Technology
introductionZh:
本数据集是基于时序InSAR技术（SBAS-InSAR），利用欧空局（ESA）Sentinel-1A 卫星提供的2023年1月至2025年5月覆盖G109青藏公路全线的宽幅干涉模式SAR影像，获取得到G109沿线区域年均形变速率。并根据年均形变速率，运用Sobel算子提取了研究区空间沉降梯度场信息，并以形变速率绝对值大于10 mm/year 或沉降空间梯度模长大于 1.6 mm/year/m 为两个阈值，对变形量显著且变形空间变化剧烈（可能指示不均匀沉降、滑坡边界等）的高风险区域进行有效识别，经过二值化与矢量化输出了G109青藏公路地质隐患识别结果数据。

本数据集采用中国大地坐标系2000（CGCS 2000），EPSG编码为4490。G109沿线区域地表形变速率栅格数据与G109沿线区域形变速率空间梯度模长栅格数据储存格式为GeoTIFF，分别命名为“Deformation_Rate_G109_2023-2025.tif”与“Gradient_Magnitude_G109_2023-2025.tif”，其中G109沿线形变速率栅格像元值单位为mm· year-1，负值表示远离卫星（通常解释为沉降），正值表示靠近卫星（通常解释为抬升）。G109沿线地质隐患双要素识别结果是根据双要素判定公式提取出的潜在沉降及滑坡风险区域矢量面数据，储存格式为SHP，命名为“Risk_Zones_G109_2023-2025.shp”。

 本数据集在数据处理中采用精密轨道数据与COP-DEM GLO30地形数据，结合高程线性拟合与空间滤波，有效抑制了非地质体变形信号。多轨道拼接处过渡平滑，沉降速率分布符合算法假设，数据精度可靠。本数据集系统揭示了G109公路沿线冻土退化引起的地表变形特征，可为公路路基病害识别、冻土工程研究与交通管理提供科学依据。
introductionEn:
This dataset is derived using time-series InSAR technology (SBAS-InSAR) and wide-swath interferometric mode SAR images provided by the European Space Agency's (ESA) Sentinel-1A satellite, covering the entire length of the G109 Qinghai-Tibet Highway from January 2023 to May 2025. It provides the average annual deformation rate for the areas along the G109 corridor. Based on the annual deformation rate, the spatial settlement gradient field of the study area was extracted using the Sobel operator. Two thresholds were applied for effective identification of high-risk areas exhibiting significant deformation and intense spatial variation in deformation (which may indicate uneven settlement, landslide boundaries, etc.): an absolute deformation rate greater than 10 mm/year or a spatial gradient magnitude greater than 1.6 mm/year/m. The resulting identified geohazard zones along the G109 Qinghai-Tibet Highway were output as binary and vectorized data.

The dataset adopts the China Geodetic Coordinate System 2000 (CGCS 2000), with an EPSG code of 4490. The raster data for the surface deformation rate and the spatial gradient magnitude of the deformation rate along the G109 corridor are stored in GeoTIFF format, named "Deformation_Rate_G109_2023-2025.tif" and "Gradient_Magnitude_G109_2023-2025.tif" respectively. The pixel values in the deformation rate raster represent mm·year?1, where negative values indicate movement away from the satellite (typically interpreted as subsidence) and positive values indicate movement towards the satellite (typically interpreted as uplift). The vector polygon data identifying potential geohazards along G109, derived based on the dual-criteria, is stored in SHP format and named "Risk_Zones_G109_2023-2025.shp".

During data processing, precise orbit ephemerides and the COP-DEM GLO30 topographic data were utilized. Combined with linear elevation fitting and spatial filtering, this approach effectively suppressed non-geological deformation signals. Transitions in multi-track stitching areas are smooth, and the distribution of subsidence rates conforms to algorithmic assumptions, ensuring reliable data accuracy. This dataset systematically reveals the characteristics of surface deformation induced by permafrost degradation along the G109 highway, providing a scientific basis for road subgrade disease identification, permafrost engineering research, and traffic management.

titleZh: FR2KG
titleEn: FR2KG
introductionZh:
来自金融研报的知识图谱，由金融领域的投研专家通过达观数据渊海知识图谱平台上标注，包含有10种实体类型、19种关系和若干属性，详情请参考文章:

Wang, W.G., et al.: Data set and evaluation of automated construction of financial knowledge graph. Data Intelligence 3(3), (2021). doi: 10.1162/dint_a_00108
introductionEn:
First, 1,200 financial research reports were collected. Experts in the financial field analyzed these reports, extracted the plain text from the main body, and saved it in the TXT format as the basic unstructured text corpus. Then, the experts and the knowledge graph team studied these corpora together, designed the schema of the knowledge graph from the perspective of financial business, and performed iterative optimization according to the characteristics of the evaluation, and finally, determined that it contained 10 entity types, 6 entity attributes, and 19 relationships between the entities. Subsequently, these corpora were annotated with the help of the annotation system of the Yuanhai Knowledge Graph Platform, which is a product of DataGrand Inc. The annotation system is specifically used for the annotation of the knowledge graph, and supports the annotation of entities, entity attributes, and relationships between entities. Before annotating, all annotators were trained by financial experts to align their understanding of the schema. All annotated data were reviewed by experts, and then, divided into seed KG and evaluation KG, as described in the previous section. 


Reference：Wang, W.G., et al.: Data set and evaluation of automated construction of financial knowledge graph. Data Intelligence 3(3), (2021). doi: 10.1162/dint_a_00108

titleZh: 唐代丝绸之路东中段交通线路数据集（618-907年）
titleEn: the Datasets of the East-central Silk Road Routes in the Tang Dynasty (618-907year)
introductionZh: 丝绸之路交通线路是进行丝绸之路研究的重要基础，唐代丝绸之路交通路线奠定了历史丝绸之路交通的基本框架。本文以唐代（618-907年）丝绸之路东中段交通为研究对象，综合利用历史文献、考古成果，以及历史地理学和地理信息系统方法建立交通线路数据集，尽可能客观地反映唐代丝绸之路东中段交通面貌。本数据不仅可直接用于表征唐代丝绸之路东中段交通线路的整体状况，也可检索某年份的交通情况，是开展唐代丝绸之路科学研究的重要基础数据集。
introductionEn: The route of the Silk Road is an important foundation for the study of the Silk Road. The Silk Road in the Tang dynasty laid the basic framework of the historical Silk Road transportation. In this paper, Taking the East-central route of the silk road in the Tang dynasty (618-907) as the research object, comprehensive utilizing of the historical documents and archaeological achievements, as well as historical geography and geographic information system method to establish the silk road traffic route datasets, in order to objectively reflect the appearance of the East-central Silk Road in the Tang dynasty as far as possible. titleZh: A dataset of GRACE intersatellite geopotential differences from April 2002 to July 2016
titleEn: A dataset of GRACE intersatellite geopotential differences from April 2002 to July 2016
introductionZh:
Gravity Recovery and Climate Experiment (GRACE) satellite gravimetry can monitor surface mass variations with a spatial resolution of ~300km and a temporal resolution of 1 month. GRACE intersatellite geopotential difference (GPD) is a type of in-situ gravimetric observables with explicit geophysical interpretation, which can directly reflect surface mass variations.

 

The intersatellite GPDs are estimated from GRACE Level-1B (RL03) data (including KBR range-rate measurements (KBR1B), satellite orbits (GNV1B), accelerometer measurements (ACC1B), and satellite attitude measurements (SCA1B)) based on an improved energy balance equation, and the orbit and background model errors are reduced using empirical parameters based on the remove-compute-restore (RCR) technique. Background models used for estimating GRACE intersatellite GPDs are consistent with GRACE Level-2 Processing Standards Document (for Level-2 Product RL06).

 

GRACE intersatellite GPD data are processed over the period from April 2002 to July 2016 with a sampling rate of 5s along the satellite orbits (orbit height is ~450km), and stored on a monthly basis. There are total 155 months of data files over the period from April 2002 to July 2016, and the other 17 months of data are not available due to the instrument failure or other influencing factors. Each data file includes the positions of GRACE satellites A and B in Earth-centered Earth-fixed (ECEF) coordinate system, intersatellite geopotential differences after deducting the mean gravity field model GGM05C (i.e., the disturbance potential difference TAB=TB-TA), and the corresponding quality flags.

 

GRACE intersatellite GPD data are validated through the estimation of monthly gravity field solutions and regional surface mass variations. The estimates inferred from GPD data are compared with GRACE official monthly solutions and mascon solutions, such as the products published by the Center for Space Research (CSR), Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL), German Research Center for Geosciences (GFZ), and Goddard Space Flight Center (GSFC). It is demonstrated that the differences between GPD-inferred results and the official released models are within the range of the differences among those official models. 

 

GRACE intersatellite GPD dataset enriches the GRACE data products, and can be applied to directly invert the monthly gravity field models, global and regional surface mass variations, which is helpful to study the terrestrial water cycle, ice sheets and mountain glacier mass balance, sea level change, and ocean bottom pressure variations, etc.
